project_summary: Extend the existing file-backed schedule system to support one indefinite weekly schedule across multiple weekdays and selected local times. Keep each series as one manageable schedule record, expose it through schedule_action and the Schedule page, and render its occurrences as a visually connected, identifiable series while retaining legacy recurrence compatibility.
assumptions_unresolved_questions: Represent selected weekdays as integers Sunday=0 through Saturday=6 and selected weekly times as local HH:mm values. Keep ScheduleItem.time as the existing local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm occurrence/anchor field; add optional weekly-selection fields so old records and non-weekly schedules remain compatible.

For a new multi-day weekly series, the chosen date is the earliest eligible date: run at its selected time if that weekday is selected, otherwise at the next selected weekday. All selected times apply on each selected weekday; repeat indefinitely without an end date or occurrence limit.

Legacy weekly schedules without weekday/time selections keep their current once-a-week behavior based on their stored date and time. Changing recurrence away from weekly must not change existing daily, monthly, or one-time behavior.
Canceling a schedule deletes its single record and prevents future occurrences. There is no established in-flight cancellation mechanism; an occurrence already executing may finish.

Update the existing project README only if it is the appropriate current location for user-facing schedule guidance; otherwise update the already-established schedule documentation location, if one exists, without creating unrelated documentation structure.
acceptance_criteria: A weekly schedule can select multiple weekdays and one or more local times, remains one record, and continues without an end date until canceled.

The scheduler fires all selected weekday/time occurrences, advances the same record to the next eligible occurrence, and handles missed occurrences without breaking existing catch-up policy or legacy weekly schedules.
schedule_action can create, list/show, update, and cancel a series; selected days and times are reported, invalid selections are rejected, and existing inputs without the new fields continue to work.

The Schedule page can create and edit multi-day/multi-time series, shows its occurrences in the agenda and month calendar, and draws a continuous, recognizable same-schedule line/marker across its selected weekday cells; one delete cancels the entire series.

Focused automated coverage validates selection and occurrence calculation, persistence/legacy compatibility, schedule_action management/reporting, and calendar/agenda presentation where supported by the existing test setup. Relevant TypeScript validation and schedule guidance are updated.

actions: Extend src/schedule/types.ts with optional weekly weekday and local-time selections on ScheduleItem; preserve existing recurrence values and the existing time field.
Update src/schedule/storage.ts creation/update normalization only as needed to persist selections without synthesizing selections for legacy records or migrating stored data.

Add focused type/storage tests proving new selections persist and old weekly and non-weekly records load unchanged. Validate day/time values at the appropriate input boundary rather than silently normalizing invalid user input.
steps.expected_result: The existing single-record schedule model can carry multi-day/multi-time weekly selection while old persisted schedules retain their prior interpretation.

actions: Update src/schedule/scheduler.ts occurrence selection for weekly series to compute the next eligible local weekday/time from the schedule's current occurrence and selections, updating the same record after reminder and agent runs.

Preserve once-weekly behavior when selection fields are absent and retain existing daily, none, monthly, failure, and catch-up behavior; ensure future-occurrence search can skip arbitrarily many missed weekly occurrences without imposing an end/iteration limit that strands an indefinite series.

Add focused scheduler tests for multiple times per selected day, selected weekdays and week rollover, start-date eligibility, missed-occurrence advancement, legacy weekly behavior, and unaffected recurrence types.
steps.expected_result: The same pending weekly record advances indefinitely to the next selected local occurrence and legacy/non-weekly schedules keep their established semantics.

actions: Extend the schema and handling in src/schedule/schedule-tool.ts to accept optional weekday and weekly-time selections on create/update, validate explicit selections, and include them in list and update output and tool guidance.

Keep old schedule_action inputs valid; ensure cancel by id deletes the one series record, and make date-filtered listing account for recurring weekly occurrences only if required to accurately show the queried date under existing list semantics.
Add focused tool tests for multi-day/multi-time create, list, update, cancellation, invalid/empty selections, and legacy requests that omit the new fields.
steps.expected_result: Agent callers can manage and understand one complete weekly series without separate records per weekday or time, and existing callers remain compatible.

actions: Update src/schedule/components/SchedulePage.tsx to edit/create weekday and time selections, retain compatible defaults when editing legacy weekly schedules, and persist the selections with the one schedule record.

Build the visible month occurrences and selected-day agenda from applicable recurring weekdays/times rather than only the anchor date; show the selected occurrence times without duplicating the schedule identity or its delete action.

Render visually continuous, same-series markers across adjacent selected weekday cells, distinguish the series by schedule identity/style from isolated single-date dots, and add only the necessary styles in src/schedule/components/schedule.css. Add focused SchedulePage coverage if the existing test setup supports rendering this component.
steps.expected_result: Users can manage one multi-day series from the planner, see its real occurrences in calendar and agenda, recognize connected markers as one schedule, and cancel all future occurrences with one delete.

actions: Update the established user-facing schedule documentation (README.md only if it is the appropriate location) to explain multi-weekday/multi-time indefinite repetition and single-record cancellation, while noting legacy schedule compatibility where useful.

Run the focused schedule model/storage, scheduler, and schedule_action tests from the preceding changes, plus focused UI coverage if added; run the project TypeScript check once. Do not expand verification to unrelated suites or fix unrelated failures.
steps.expected_result: Relevant schedule guidance describes the new behavior, and the targeted schedule behavior and project type compatibility are verified.
